summary: Compares three approaches for configuring the address of an IPv6 recursive DNS server on a host: a Router Advertisement option, a DHCPv6 option, and well-known anycast addresses. It describes where each fits in ISP, enterprise, 3GPP, and unmanaged networks. The document is informational.

eli5.summary: To look up a name, your computer needs to know which phone book to ask. This compares three ways it can be told when it joins a network.
